Class ToolResource

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.tool.api.ToolResource
@Path("/api/v1/mcp/tools") @Produces("application/json") @Consumes("application/json") public class ToolResource extends Object
============================================================================ MCP SERVER REST API ============================================================================ RESTful API for MCP tool management and execution. Endpoints: - POST /api/v1/mcp/tools/openapi - Generate tools from OpenAPI - GET /api/v1/mcp/tools - List tools - GET /api/v1/mcp/tools/{toolId} - Get tool details - POST /api/v1/mcp/tools/{toolId}/execute - Execute tool - POST /api/v1/mcp/auth-profiles - Create auth profile
